name: Databricks
tagline: The data + AI platform behind Spark, Delta Lake and MLflow. Loop: recruiter call, ~60 min technical phone screen (CoderPad), then an onsite with 2-3 coding rounds, system design and a hiring-manager round.
notes: The same handful of questions come up again and again: the CIDR / IP firewall rule matcher (first-match allow/deny, plus a whole-block follow-up), the snapshot set iterator, a key-value store that reports GET/PUT load over the last 5 minutes, the fastest commute mode on a grid (BFS per mode, follow-up allowing mode switches), and n x n / k-in-a-row tic-tac-toe. Interviewers want working, well-structured code fast, then push on complexity (O(1) iterator creation, O(32) IP lookups, bounded memory for the QPS window) and on edge cases. Expect follow-ups to be added live.
